questions.question: A small office needs forwarding between its LAN and a WAN IP network. Which role provides that function?
questions.explanation: A router forwards IP packets between networks.

option_explanations.A: A PoE injector adds electrical power rather than routing IP packets.
option_explanations.C: A patch panel terminates cabling and performs no forwarding.
option_explanations.D: A router forwards IP packets between networks.

questions.question: Which device provides a radio attachment point for Wi-Fi clients on a wired LAN?

options.D: WAN router with no wireless radio

questions.explanation: The AP supplies the over-the-air link and attaches clients to the network.

option_explanations.A: A controller manages APs, but a controller alone does not supply the client-facing radio.
option_explanations.B: The AP supplies the over-the-air link and attaches clients to the network.
option_explanations.C: A hub supports wired physical-layer connections.
option_explanations.D: A device without a wireless radio cannot be the Wi-Fi attachment point.

questions.question: Which device forwards local Ethernet frames by learned destination MAC rather than routing between IP networks?

options.A: Wireless LAN controller managing AP firmware

questions.explanation: An L2 switch uses a MAC forwarding table. A hub repeats signals without lookup.

option_explanations.A: Managing AP firmware is not the local Ethernet switching role.
option_explanations.B: A hub repeats rather than learning destination addresses.
option_explanations.C: A routed interface forwards using destination IP and rewrites link-layer headers for each hop.
option_explanations.D: An L2 switch uses a MAC forwarding table. A hub repeats signals without lookup.

questions.question: A campus needs one device to switch within VLANs and route between its VLAN gateways. Which device fits both roles?
questions.explanation: A capable Layer 3 switch can combine MAC switching and IP routing.

option_explanations.A: A hub does not switch within VLANs or route between them.
option_explanations.B: A midspan supplies power rather than processing forwarding headers.
option_explanations.C: A capable Layer 3 switch can combine MAC switching and IP routing.
option_explanations.D: A Layer 2 switch alone does not route between VLAN gateways.

questions.question: Which role enforces policy on which network sessions may cross the boundary between two security zones?
questions.explanation: A firewall applies traffic policy at the security boundary.

option_explanations.A: A PoE source supplies power but does not enforce session policy.
option_explanations.B: A firewall applies traffic policy at the security boundary.
option_explanations.C: A hub repeats signals without considering connection policy.
option_explanations.D: A repeater operates below the layers where firewall sessions are classified.

questions.question: Which device role inspects live traffic for known attack patterns and can block matching traffic inline?
questions.explanation: An inline intrusion prevention system can detect and stop policy-matching traffic.

option_explanations.A: A hub repeats signals without inspecting attack signatures.
option_explanations.B: A media converter changes the physical medium without making prevention decisions.
option_explanations.C: An out-of-band monitor can observe traffic but is outside the forwarding path and cannot drop inline packets itself.
option_explanations.D: An inline intrusion prevention system can detect and stop policy-matching traffic.

questions.question: A campus wants centralized configuration for many lightweight APs. What device fills that management role?
questions.explanation: A WLC coordinates compatible APs and centralizes wireless policy and configuration.

option_explanations.A: A hub has no configuration-control relationship with APs.
option_explanations.B: A local injector powers an AP but does not centrally manage it.
option_explanations.C: An unmanaged switch can carry traffic, but it is not an AP management platform.
option_explanations.D: A WLC coordinates compatible APs and centralizes wireless policy and configuration.

questions.question: A company needs centralized enterprise call control for its Cisco IP phones. Which platform addresses that function?
questions.explanation: Unified Communications Manager handles functions such as call setup and routing for enterprise voice endpoints.

option_explanations.A: Unified Communications Manager handles functions such as call setup and routing for enterprise voice endpoints.
option_explanations.B: The Catalyst access switch attaches phones to the LAN, and may power them, but does not provide this call control role.
option_explanations.C: A Nexus switch is aimed at data-center networking.
option_explanations.D: A WLC manages WLANs and APs rather than enterprise phone call policy.

questions.question: A data center needs a device that aggregates server Ethernet links and provides high-speed uplinks. Which Cisco family is aimed at that switching role?
questions.explanation: Nexus is Cisco's data-center switching family, while the others address voice or wireless roles.

option_explanations.A: Nexus is Cisco's data-center switching family, while the others address voice or wireless roles.
option_explanations.C: Unified Communications Manager handles call control.
option_explanations.D: An IP Phone 8800 is a voice endpoint, not a data-center switch.

questions.question: Mobiles still associate to their APs and reach the local default gateway. The gateway can reach a server behind the firewall, but the firewall logs deny the client subnet for that service. Which component owns the restriction?

options.A: The access point providing radio coverage
options.C: The firewall enforcing the client policy
options.D: The switch learning the client MACs

questions.explanation: The associations and local path work. The logged policy deny identifies the firewall boundary as the source of this restriction.

option_explanations.A: Association and gateway reachability show that the AP's access function is working.
option_explanations.B: The WLC is not the component logging the client-subnet service denial.
option_explanations.C: The associations and local path work. The logged policy deny identifies the firewall boundary as the source of this restriction.
option_explanations.D: MAC learning supplies local forwarding, not the security-zone rule shown in the log.
